name: Johanngeorgenstadt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Johanngeorgenstadt (a red church above crossed hammers on white).
history: Municipal flag of Johanngeorgenstadt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Johanngeorgenstadt arms — church and hammers on white
